sanskrit_verse:
कूटाक्षदेविनः पापान् निर्भजेद् द्यूतमण्डलात्।
कण्ठेsक्षमालामासज्य स ह्येषां विनयः स्मृतः॥
transliteration: kūṭākṣadevinaḥ pāpān nirbhajed dyūtamaṇḍalāt | kaṇṭhe 'kṣamālām āsajya sa hy eṣāṃ vinayaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One who engages in deceitful gambling must be severed from the assembly of players; placing the sacred thread upon his neck signifies his removal from the fold of disciplined society.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in discernment between dharma and adharma within social assemblies
Causation arises through conscious distortion of fairness and integrity
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by awareness of ethical consequence
Restoration logic requires realignment with societal dharmic order
Consciousness alignment necessitates visible symbolic correction for communal clarity
executable_legal_axioms: IF an individual intentionally manipulates game outcomes through deception THEN remove that individual from all sanctioned competitive assemblies
IF a person knowingly participates in fraudulent gambling THEN their eligibility for ritual or civic recognition SHALL be suspended visibly via symbolic markers
IF a participant demonstrates repeated violation of fair-play codes THEN automatic disqualification AND public notification SHALL occur without punitive intent
IF community integrity is compromised by hidden malice THEN visible corrective action MUST restore collective trust
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating disputes involving fraud in games or competitions, the Supreme Court must prioritize severance from institutional participation over punitive damages. The court's role is to uphold dharma-vyavastha—the structural alignment of conduct—by ensuring violators are visibly excluded until completion and reintegration protocols are fulfilled.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that untruthful action distorts harmony. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows how deceit undermines systemic trust. Proportional response lies not in harm but in separation enabling purification. Non-punitive reality rule affirms that exclusion serves consciousness correction, not vengeance.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Participant completes reflective study on ethics in competition under spiritual supervision
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Public acknowledgment of harm caused to group integrity
Capacity Restoration: Re-entry allowed only after demonstration of renewed commitment to truthful engagement
Integrity Reintegration: Ceremony of reaffirming vows before community elders post-rehabilitation
final_declaration: By the Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands executed. Dharma is restored through conscious separation, not suffering. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone is the Supreme Adjudicator.
